ItemID: 1; Title: Fire TV Stick streaming device with Alexa built in, includes Alexa Voice Remote, HD, latest release; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already have a Fire TV Stick 4K and a Fire TV television, so another HD stick adds little.
ItemID: 2; Title: Echo Show 5 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- Smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Charcoal; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: A smart display interests me alongside my Fire TV devices, but I would explore the larger Show 8 first.
ItemID: 3; Title: Echo Dot (3rd Gen, 2018 release) - Smart speaker with Alexa - Charcoal; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I do not currently need a separate speaker just for Alexa voice access.
ItemID: 4; Title: Fire HD 10 Tablet (10.1" 1080p full HD display, 64 GB) – Black (2019 Release); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent purchases focus on television and cameras, and I have no clear need for a tablet right now.
ItemID: 5; Title: Amazon Smart Plug, for home automation, Works with Alexa - A Certified for Humans Device; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no specific appliance I want to automate, so I would skip this.
ItemID: 6; Title: SanDisk 32GB 2-Pack Ultra MicroSDHC UHS-I Memory Card (2x32GB) - SDSQUAR-032G-GN6MT; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I would need to confirm a storage requirement and device compatibility before buying these cards.
ItemID: 7; Title: Blink Mini – Compact indoor plug-in smart security camera, 1080p HD video, night vision, motion detection, two-way audio, easy set up, Works with Alexa – 3 cameras (Black); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I already use Blink, and this looks useful for expanding indoor coverage, though three cameras may be more than I need.
ItemID: 8; Title: Echo Show 8 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- HD smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Sandstone; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: The larger display and video calling offer a useful new function alongside my existing Fire TV setup.
ItemID: 9; Title: 64GB EVO Select Memory Card and Sabrent SuperSpeed 2-Slot USB 3.0 Flash Memory Card Reader; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The reader could help transfer recordings, but I have no confirmed need for this card and reader bundle.
ItemID: 10; Title: WYZE Cam v2 - White; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Another security camera fits my interests, but I would investigate the Blink option first because I already own a Blink camera.
